label: batch-100
tail:
Batch 100 authoring and evidence are complete. The A page has 21 items and the B page has 2; all item dependency levels were recomputed. The new trefoil rank proof states the positive braid and smoothing conventions explicitly, and the example drawing now matches them.

**Readiness:** 8 items are marked ready and 15 escalated. The escalations preserve the full claims and identify gaps in closed-manifold Floer analysis, surgery/TQFT maps, the trefoil cover slope and disk count, and an owner-held Khovanov Reidemeister sign issue. The Ozsváth–Szabó paper describes projection independence of the filtered quasi-isomorphism type as expected; the authored theorem does not claim it ([§1.1](https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/0309170v1)).

**Checks:** Strict proof contracts, content policy, coverage, proof layout, rendering, and the scoped dependency closure passed. The scoped closure contains 39 items across 9 pages. Precheck reports `no-qed` for the 12 escalated proof-bearing items; no incomplete proof was marked complete. The B example’s escalation record remains unchanged; its stored digest predates the diagram-only correction, as recorded in the notes.

The active run remains at 89/109 with no worker in flight and an existing owner-held Step 1 blocker. Run-wide checks also report empty inventories and an unrelated dependency-level mismatch; the global cross-batch refresh encounters an invalid batch-108 input.
